name: agentic-dev
description: You drive a loose loop, Frame, Explore, Build, Verify, Review, and a machine decides when it is done: a task skill for a change whose done one check proves: it asks at most one clarifying question and for the done check, writes the check where the agent doing the work cannot see it, sees it fail, and has a subagent make it pass from the simplest solution up in its own worktree; a prototyping skill that answers one question with throwaway code (a spike or proof of concept) with no tests or clean code, then deletes it; a reviewing skill that has a fresh agent review a finished change and a second prove or drop each finding, then fixes the blocking ones test-first within 3 rounds; a reflecting skill that has a fresh agent read the session of a finished change and tells you what to do next time; plus hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers, switch a checker off, or change, remove or skip a test the branch started with, a gate that hides a task's check from the subagent, a gate on the first edit the task or prototyping skill did not frame, a gate on a pull request or merge no review preceded, and a reminder to run the reflecting skill once a branch is merged or opened as a pull request.
